description: Source code for a Linux-specific package validator in Kubernetes, handling package version checks, OS detection, and package management via dpkg.

classes.name: dpkg
classes.description: Implementation of packageManager for Debian-based systems.

methods.name: newPackageManager
methods.description: Creates a packageManager instance based on available package managers.

methods.name: newDPKG
methods.description: Checks for presence of dpkg-query and returns a dpkg instance if available.

methods.name: getPackageVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version of a package using dpkg-query.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the validator.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates package specifications against the system.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks each package against its version range.

methods.name: resolvePackageName
methods.description: Replaces variables in package names with system info.

methods.name: applyPackageSpecOverride
methods.description: Applies overrides to package specifications based on OS.

methods.name: extractUpstreamVersion
methods.description: Extracts upstream version from dpkg version string.

methods.name: toSemVerRange
methods.description: Converts version range strings to semantic version range format.

methods.name: toSemVer
methods.description: Converts a version string to semantic version format.
